source: GearBox_adddingImg v1 by Vjs, Roboflow Universe (https://universe.roboflow.com/vjs-jek7v/gearbox_adddingimg), CC BY 4.0; COCO export of 2026-11-02
modality: real photographs of small manufactured gears (camera); NOT the slewing ring of the sensor side, and not the same faults
task: classify one tooth crop as good or damaged (box labels goodTeeth vs Breakage, Gear tooth breakage, Wear and Tear, badTeeth, damage, pitting, teethCrack, tooth failure)
test: leave one video or photo set out (frames of one video never in both training and test); frozen ImageNet ResNet-18 features + logistic regression (C 0.1, balanced), fixed in advance
selection: cnn_features (main): setting fixed before any result was seen (margin 0.15, C 0.1); cnn_selected (check): crop margin (0.15 or 0.5 of the box) and C (0.01, 0.1, 1) chosen per held-out source by 4-fold grouped validation inside the training sources
caveat: uploader unknown, no description; 645 of 838 images are frames of 15 short videos and 279 frames appear more than once; damaged teeth come from few sources; manufacturing defects on small gears, not field wear of a grader circle
